name: app-project-workflow
description: Make Claude Code a careful teammate on software projects. Sets up a PRD, a work board, session notes, and rules that Claude asks before guessing and proves work with real test runs. For bigger jobs a router agent plans tickets that worker, tester, and reviewer agents do in separate git worktrees, checked by a scope and test guard. Setup: /app-project-workflow:adopt (existing project) or :bootstrap (new folder).
